title: Clock offset, mis-recorded coordinate and regional speed change
description: Three distinct fault signatures coexist: S1's clock steps +180 ms late in the boot while the single-segment calibration stays valid, leaving a same-sign residual from every direction; S2 is registered 80 m from its true position (residual reverses with source direction); and the region really propagates at 328 m/s while the service baseline stays 343 m/s (residual grows with source distance). One grossly anomalous S3 anchor is injected so the diagnosis must document its exclusion before/after.
